events.statement: order-service was deployed to v2.14.0 at 2026-03-03T12:10:00Z by r.iyer, 12 minutes before the 12:22Z report; summary is 'Refactor order validation; add margin check for F&O orders' with changes 'new MarginCheckValidator in validation chain' and 'remove legacy OrderRules.validateMargin()'. Status is 'live' with rolled_back_at: null.
The only other deployment in the 24h window is portfolio-service v4.2.1 at 2026-03-03T09:36:00Z ('Dependency bumps', 'bump grpc 1.62 -> 1.63'), i.e. 2h46m before the 12:22Z onset, status live.

Exactly one config change occurred in the 24h window: notification-service key email.batch_size 200 -> 250 at 2026-03-03T11:21:00Z (config-bot, 'Tune email batching'). It belongs to notification-service, which is not in order-service's dependency graph.

A tighter config-change query for 2026-03-03T11:50:00Z–13:59:00Z (covering the onset) returned count 0 across all services, partial:false — no config or flag change anywhere in the 32 minutes before through 97 minutes after onset.

order-service dependency map: outbound edges to ledger-db (db), pricing-engine (http), exchange-gateway (http), kafka (queue-produce); inbound from api-gateway (http); pricing-engine itself calls market-data-service and redis-cache. events.answer: Across all services in the last 24h there were exactly two deployments and one config change. The one closest to the onset (12:22Z) is order-service v2.14.0 at 12:10Z — "Refactor order validation; add margin check for F&O orders" — a validation-path change that matches the reported symptom (derivatives/F&O orders returning 500) and is still live (not rolled back). The other change, portfolio-service v4.2.1 (09:36Z), is ~2h46m before onset and is a grpc patch bump. No config/flag change occurred inside 11:50–13:59Z. order-service's shared components are ledger-db, redis-cache and kafka, with pricing-engine and exchange-gateway as HTTP dependencies; four precedent incidents involve exactly these neighbours (ledger-db, kafka) plus two prior order-service config/deploy failures.

events.statement: order-service ERROR logs start at 12:12:31Z with 'NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88) orderType=FNO' and continue through 13:58:50Z; 426 ERROR entries were matched, all of the two marginProfile/NPE patterns.

The 500 error signature is a null margin profile: 'order rejected with 500: java.lang.NullPointerException: marginProfile is null for account <n>' (202 occurrences), alongside 224 NPE-at-MarginCheckValidator occurrences.

The error rate metric crosses from baseline to incident level in the 12:10:00Z 5-minute bucket: avg 11.17% / max 19.63%, versus 0.16-0.26% for every bucket from 11:00 to 12:05Z. Onset is therefore ~12:10Z, i.e. about 12 minutes before the 12:22Z report.
Error rate plateaus at ~18-19% and has not recovered by the latest data: buckets from 12:15Z through 13:55Z all avg 18.0-19.0% (peak max 20.19%), last bucket 13:55Z avg 18.74%.

Every error sample names orderType=FNO; a filtered query for 'orderType=' returned 224 ERROR matches, 224 of which are the FNO MarginCheckValidator NPE pattern, and no non-FNO error pattern appears in the top_patterns.
order-service latency_p99_ms is flat across the whole window (144-165ms, every 8-min bucket 11:00-13:56Z ~147-153ms), showing no latency degradation accompanying the error spike.

The known_services list (api-gateway, auth-service, order-service, portfolio-service, pricing-engine, market-data-service, payment-service, settlement-service, notification-service, exchange-gateway, ledger-db, user-db, redis-cache, kafka, exchange-api, bank-partner-api, kyc-provider, email-provider) contains no dedicated margin/account service, so the margin-profile lookup path in order-service is not visible in telemetry.

events.answer: order-service's 500 error rate on POST /v1/orders began at ~12:10-12:12Z, roughly 10 minutes BEFORE the 12:22Z report, jumping from a ~0.2% baseline to ~18% (peak 20.19% at 12:30Z) and staying there through 13:59Z. Every sampled error is a NullPointerException in MarginCheckValidator.validate (MarginCheckValidator.java:88) on orderType=FNO (derivatives), so the failure appears confined to derivatives/F&O orders rather than all order types. No downstream RPC, timeout, or dependency errors appear in order-service logs, and latency_p99 stays flat at ~150ms, so this is a pure application error, not a slowdown or downstream dependency failure. I could not scan the other services' error rates for concurrent anomalies before the budget expired.

events.statement: order-service v2.14.0 rollout completed at 12:10:08Z ('deployment dep-5101 (v2.14.0) rollout complete, all pods ready'), and the very next ERROR entries in the same log stream begin at 12:12:31Z with the MarginCheckValidator NPE — no ERROR of any kind appears in this stream before the rollout; the preceding INFO entries (11:56:19Z health check ok, 11:59:51Z scheduled job heartbeat ok, 12:07:51Z config reloaded (no changes)) show a clean pre-rollout state.

The failing error signature is a newly-introduced validator: two patterns dominate order-service logs — 'NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88) orderType=FNO' and 'order rejected with 500: java.lang.NullPointerException: marginProfile is null for account <n>' — matching the v2.14.0 change 'new MarginCheckValidator in validation chain'. Both first appear only after 12:10Z (12:12:31Z and 12:12:44Z respectively).

api-gateway (order-service's inbound HTTP caller, i.e. downstream casualty) shows an error_rate jump that starts in the SAME 12:12Z bucket as the order-service errors: from a flat baseline of 0.20-0.28% for every 11:00-12:00Z bucket to avg 3.41% / max 3.66% at 12:12:00Z, staying elevated (3.33-3.46%) through 13:48Z. Its onset is consistent with, and explained by, downstream propagation of order-service 500s.

The shared components flagged in T2 show NO anomaly at or around onset: ledger-db connections_active is flat (avg 61.0-63.1 connections across every 11:00-13:48Z bucket, min 56.25 / max 67.78 overall — no pool exhaustion), and kafka under_replicated_partitions is 0.0 for every bucket across the whole window (no broker/rebalance problem).

pricing-engine — order-service's other HTTP dependency — shows no error anomaly at all: its error_rate is flat 0.19-0.25% avg (max 0.28-0.32%) across every 11:00-13:48Z bucket, including the 12:12Z bucket. It is not temporally correlated with the onset.

Temporal ordering places the order-service deploy as the only candidate event immediately preceding onset: the deploy completed at 12:10:08Z (tc-017), the error-rate metric crosses into incident level in the 12:10Z bucket (T1/F9), and the first ERROR log is 12:12:31Z. No other change lies in this window (T2: the only other deploy, portfolio-service v4.2.1, was at 09:36Z, ~2h46m earlier; no config change in 11:50-13:59Z).

events.answer: The candidate that is temporally consistent with the onset is the order-service v2.14.0 deploy: its rollout completed at 12:10:08Z and the first MarginCheckValidator NPE errors appear at 12:12:31Z, with the error-rate metric crossing into incident level in the 12:10Z bucket (onset ~12:10Z per T1). The change 'add margin check for F&O orders / new MarginCheckValidator in validation chain' directly matches the FNO-only NPE signature, making it the likely fault origin rather than a downstream casualty. All dependency-side candidates are inconsistent: ledger-db connections_active is flat (~62), kafka under_replicated_partitions is 0, pricing-engine error_rate is flat (~0.22%), and api-gateway's concurrent error jump (0.2%->3.4%) starts in the same 12:12Z bucket and is best read as downstream propagation of order-service 500s.
